description_en: Queries metric data for the Tunnel Data Transmission Service within a specified time range
description_zh: 用于查询指定时间范围内的Tunnel数据传输服务相关指标数据
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute query-tunnel-metric --start-time 1735534322 --end-time 1735536322 --metric slot_usage --strategy max --quota-nickname default --project project_a --table-list tab_name --operation-list upload --code-list 403 --group-list quota --topn 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryTunnelMetric

parameters.description_en: The start of the time range for the query.
parameters.description_zh: 查询时间范围：开始时间。
parameters.help_en: The start of the time range for the query
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围：开始时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end of the time range for the query.
parameters.description_zh: 查询时间范围：结束时间。
parameters.help_en: The end of the time range for the query
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围：结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en:
The data aggregation policy. The default value is `max`.

Data is collected at a frequency of 1 minute. If you query data over a long time range, the automatic step size for data display may exceed 1 minute. In this case, metrics are aggregated. This parameter specifies the aggregation logic.
parameters.description_zh:
数据聚合策略。默认max。

数据的采集频率是1分钟。当查询的时间范围较大时，数据展示的自适应步长会超过1分钟，此时指标会进行聚合。该参数即指定数据的聚合逻辑。

parameters.description_en:
The nickname of the level-2 Tunnel quota.

The nickname of a shared quota is `default`.

The format of a dedicated quota nickname is `quotaNickname#subQuotaNickname`.
parameters.description_zh:
Tunnel二级Quota昵称。

共享Quota昵称是：default

独享Quota昵称的格式是：quotaNickname#subQuotaNickname

The maximum number of data entries to return.

This parameter takes effect when the grouping criterion includes `table` or `ip`.

The default value is 10. The maximum value is 100.

当分组依据包含table或ip时，该参数生效。

默认是10，最大不超过100。
